Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full policy-selector payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"Which policy can I help you with?","mode":"single","policies":[{"id":"pol-8842","name":"Auto — 2022 Tesla Model 3","type":"Auto","policyNumber":"8842","premium":142.50,"cadence":"monthly","currency":"USD","renewalDate":"2026-11-01","status":"Active","coverage":"Collision + Comprehensive · $500 deductible","badge":"Primary"},{"id":"pol-3391","name":"Homeowners — 14 Elm St","type":"Home","policyNumber":"3391","premium":1820.00,"cadence":"annual","currency":"USD","renewalDate":"2027-02-15","status":"Active","coverage":"Dwelling $420k · $1,000 deductible"},{"id":"pol-5567","name":"Term Life — 20yr","type":"Life","policyNumber":"5567","premium":48.00,"cadence":"monthly","currency":"USD","renewalDate":"2038-06-01","status":"Active","coverage":"$500,000 benefit"}],"submitText":"Continue"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): the prompt shown above the list.
- 'mode' (string, required): 'single' or 'multiple'. Use 'single' when the customer should pick exactly one policy (the card sends the choice immediately on click). Use 'multiple' when they may pick several (a submit button appears).
- 'policies' (array, REQUIRED, at least one object): each policy MUST have 'id' (string, unique, sent back on selection), 'name' (string, the plain-language policy name), 'type' (string; one of 'Auto','Home','Renters','Life','Health','Umbrella','Pet','Travel' — drives the card icon), and 'status' (string; one of 'Active','Pending','Lapsed','Cancelled'). Optional per policy: 'policyNumber' (string, shown masked as the last characters of the policy number), 'premium' (number, the recurring premium amount), 'cadence' (string such as 'monthly','annual','6-month' — how often the premium is billed), 'currency' (ISO code string, defaults to 'USD'), 'renewalDate' (string, ISO yyyy-mm-dd), 'coverage' (short string summarising limits/deductible), 'badge' (short string tag such as 'Primary').
- 'submitText' (string, optional): button label used only in 'multiple' mode; defaults to 'Continue'.

Never emit an empty 'policies' array. Use the customer's real policies from context; if none are known, ask the customer rather than inventing policy numbers. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
